name: Carrots
description: Crisp, colorful roots that are equally at home in a lunchbox or roasting pan. Remove leafy tops before storing.

storage.label: Whole
storage.preparation: Remove tops; use a ventilated bag.
storage.advice: Keep the roots in the crisper and wash before preparing.
storage.caution: Store the roots separately from their leafy tops.

buying: Choose firm roots without damaged areas.
Select the size you need for your recipe.
freshness: Discard carrots that look rotten. A storage estimate cannot guarantee safety.
leftovers: Roast with a little olive oil.

freezing.instructions: Wash, peel, and slice. Water-blanch slices for 2 minutes, cool promptly, drain, and pack with ½ inch headspace. Seal and freeze.
freezing.quality: Use frozen carrots in cooked dishes.
